conclusion: Owner confirms English/German Space recognition using the built-in microphone and speakers in a slightly noisy room, live draft updates in both languages, draft correction before explicit Submit and Stop mic during a hold. Releasing Space stops listening and leaves the draft editable and unsent. Brief Space taps insert normal spaces without starting the microphone. The Whisper/Submit attempt clears the draft but produces no observed response; end-to-end delivery remains inconclusive. Selector/permission details, language-specific final text and remaining lifecycle/device/echo cases stay open.

cases.notes: Owner reports recognition working in English and German through Space hold-to-talk; subsequent intake confirms the built-in microphone/speakers in a slightly noisy room. Accuracy is unmeasured and selector usage remains unspecified.

This does not establish Whisper delivery, hearing or a reply. Exact UI status and listener/provider conditions await confirmation. Final text after release and German-specific correction remain unreported.
